effects.does: Clicking Copy copies the proposal information or link to the clipboard.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record is changed.
effects.check: Click Copy and verify that the expected proposal content is available to paste.

effects.does: Clicking the copy icon copies the associated value to the clipboard.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record is changed.
effects.check: Click the icon and paste into a text field to verify that a value was copied.

effects.does: Clicking Ask Clara opens the Clara assistance interface.
effects.affects: Nothing in the proposal data is changed.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the assistant interface appears.

effects.does: Clicking Submit Proposal validates the required fields and starts proposal submission.
effects.affects: A valid proposal moves into approval or PO creation flow, while missing required fields block submission.
effects.leadsTo: An approval modal when custom PO is skipped, otherwise the Create PO form; validation errors remain on this screen.
effects.check: Leave a required field blank, click Submit Proposal, and verify the required-field error; then complete the fields and verify the next submission step.

effects.does: Clicking Document opens the proposal document panel.
effects.affects: It exposes the proposal's document response fields and may allow their values to be edited when the proposal is draft.
effects.check: Click Document and verify that the proposal document fields are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking Overview opens the proposal overview.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record is changed.
effects.check: Click Overview and verify that the overview content is shown.

effects.does: Clicking Allocation Summary opens the vendor allocation summary.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event record is changed.
effects.check: Click Allocation Summary and verify that the vendor allocation table is displayed.

effects.does: Clicking Comparison Sheets opens the comparison sheet workflow.
effects.affects: Nothing is changed immediately, but the comparison stages and subsequent QCS or PO steps become available.
effects.check: Click Comparison Sheets and verify that the stage comparison rows are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking Participants opens the participant list.
effects.affects: Nothing in the proposal record is changed.
effects.check: Click Participants and verify that participant records are shown.

effects.does: Clicking Order Allocation opens the order allocation view.
effects.affects: Nothing in the proposal record is changed.
effects.check: Click Order Allocation and verify that order allocation information is displayed.

effects.does: Clicking 9 hidden fields expands the fields hidden from the current proposal view.
effects.affects: It changes only the fields displayed on the screen.
effects.check: Click 9 hidden fields and verify that the additional fields become visible.

effects.does: Clicking AAC BLOCKS selects or opens the displayed item value.
effects.affects: The exact data change cannot be determined from the label alone.
effects.check: Click AAC BLOCKS and verify whether the item is selected or its details open.

effects.does: Clicking 55 KG selects or opens the displayed quantity or unit value.
effects.affects: The exact data change cannot be determined from the label alone.
effects.check: Click 55 KG and verify whether the value is selected or its details open.

effects.does: Clicking the dash selects or opens the displayed empty value.
effects.affects: The exact data change cannot be determined from the label alone.
effects.check: Click the dash and verify whether an empty value is selected or details open.

effects.does: Clicking ₹ 5,665 selects or opens the displayed amount.
effects.affects: The exact data change cannot be determined from the label alone.
effects.check: Click ₹ 5,665 and verify whether the amount is selected or its details open.

effects.does: Clicking Approval opens the proposal approval information.
effects.affects: Nothing is changed immediately, but approval requests and actions become available where applicable.
effects.check: Click Approval and verify that the approval information is displayed.

effects.does: Entering an answer fills the associated proposal document field.
effects.affects: The document response data is changed and is autosaved for the proposal.
effects.check: Enter a value, leave the field, reload the proposal, and verify that the value persists.

effects.does: The disabled Select date field cannot be edited.
effects.affects: Nothing because the control is disabled.
effects.check: Try to open or type into Select date and verify that no date can be entered.

effects.does: Typing in Search participants filters the participant list by the entered text.
effects.affects: Only the visible participant results are filtered.
effects.check: Enter a known participant name and verify that matching participant rows remain.

effects.does: Opening Select a column lets the buyer choose a column for the associated operation or view.
effects.affects: The selected column changes the displayed or targeted comparison data.
effects.check: Open Select a column and verify that available column options are listed.

effects.does: Selecting or entering a value in the answer control fills the associated proposal response.
effects.affects: The selected response changes the document data and may be autosaved.
effects.check: Choose a value and verify that the field displays it and retains it after reload.

effects.does: Turning on Show awarded bids includes awarded bids in the displayed results.
effects.affects: Only the visible bid results are filtered; the proposal record is not changed.
effects.check: Turn the switch on and verify that awarded bids appear in the results.

effects.does: The Name of the Proposed Vendor column displays the proposed vendor name.
effects.affects: Nothing because it is a table column.
effects.check: Verify that the allocation table has a column headed Name of the Proposed Vendor.

effects.does: The Total Items selected column displays the number of items selected for each proposed vendor.
effects.affects: Nothing because it is a table column.
effects.check: Verify that the allocation table displays Total Items selected values for vendors.

effects.does: The Total Amount column displays each proposed vendor's total amount.
effects.affects: Nothing because it is a table column.
effects.check: Verify that the allocation table displays a Total Amount value for each vendor.

effects.does: The Letter of Award column displays the letter-of-award value or action for each vendor.
effects.affects: Nothing because it is a table column.
effects.check: Verify that the allocation table has the Letter of Award column.

effects.does: The Letter of Award Status column displays the status of each vendor's letter of award.
effects.affects: Nothing because it is a table column.
effects.check: Verify that the allocation table displays Letter of Award Status values.

effects.does: The S No. column displays the serial number of each table row.
effects.affects: Nothing because it is a table column.
effects.check: Verify that each displayed table row has a serial number.

effects.does: The Vendor Name column displays the vendor name for each participant or bid row.
effects.affects: Nothing because it is a table column.
effects.check: Verify that vendor rows contain values under Vendor Name.

effects.does: The Vendor Code column displays the code assigned to each vendor.
effects.affects: Nothing because it is a table column.
effects.check: Verify that vendor rows contain the expected values under Vendor Code.

rules.statement: Overview: selected line items `a/b`, Tot. Proposal / L1 / Non L1 values (raw backend strings), "DDP Amount with Loading with Tolerance" only when present, RFX No + link, "Proposal Recommended By", approval workflow name and conditions — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:1012-1089
Submit with NTD: required-field errors → "Please fill all the required fields"; then `skip_custom_po` → approval modal, else Create PO form — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:380-400

Comparison Sheets: one row per stage (lot proposals keep the lot's stages plus non-RFQ/auction stages), then Master QCS, then "Proposed PO form" unless `skip_custom_po` — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:494-610

Config `ntd_required_on_proposal` → "Document" panel; templates GET `/templates/?type_identifier=document` (first saved template default), form GET `/documents/reference_forms?template_uuid=&resource_type=Proposal&resource_uuid=` — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:650-673, 778-799, 959-

the "View details" drawer for bid approvals checks `APPROVAL_TYPE.bidSelect`, which is not defined in projectProposal/constants (only create_trade/close_trade/close_event_group), so it is dead code — src/views/projectProposal/approvalSection/approvalSection.jsx:243-252, src/views/projectProposal/con

Loads GET `/proposal/:proposalId`, GET `/event_groups/:id`, the schema with `viewType = proposal`, proposal remarks, and (draft only) GET `/event_groups/:id/get_approvals?lot_no=` — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:624-634, 757-776, 822-826, src/viewModels/project/useProjectProposalView

Draft → "Submit Proposal" button for ANY viewer; non-draft → "Go back to project", NFA version dropdown, report buttons, and (requested + viewer is creator) a "Withdraw Proposal" menu — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:289, 316-318, 872-925

Allocation Summary columns: Name of the Proposed Vendor, Total Items selected, L1 / Non L1 Items selected, Total / L1 / Non L1 Amount, Payment Terms — only columns whose key exists on the FIRST vendor row — src/views/projectProposal/allocationColumns.js:1-42, src/views/projectProposal/projectProposa
Technical Specification panel only with config `show_technical_qcs_in_proposal` and the RFP stage has `bid_count > 0` — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:612-618, 801-811, 1194-1215

Draft proposal: sidebar only when the approvals list is non-empty; empty list text "No approval found for this trade." — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:636-638, src/views/projectProposal/approvalSection/approvalSection.jsx:271-279
Picking a reorder version → `/reorder-approvals?approval_uuid=`; else the other proposal page with `?lotNo=` — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:335-353

Submit is offered to non-creators; backend proposal#submit returns 2 "Insufficient parameters" for anyone but the creator — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:872-880, procol-backend app/controllers/api/proposal_controller.rb:82-83

Each changed section autosaves PUT `/documents/draft_document_response` `{forms_data, resource_type:"Proposal", resource_uuid}` — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:462-492, src/models/project/projectService.js:244-248
Document is read-only once the proposal is not draft — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:1005-1006, 686-697

Opening calls GET `/proposal/:id/approval_workflows`; first flow preselected; ≤1 flow → summary at once and button "Submit Proposal", else "Next" then "Back"/"Submit Proposal" — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:401-409, src/views/awardingFlow/approvalFlowSelection.jsx:43-57, src/views/a

Withdrawn proposal banner: "This proposal has been withdrawn by the initiator <name> at <DATE>." with remarks truncated at 400 chars and attachments — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:185-215, 931-935

Shown on non-draft proposals with `isNfaHistoryEnabled`; lists only versions of the current lot (proposal lot, else `?lotNo`) as "Version N" + status tag; current version disabled — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:355-362, 890-896, src/views/projectProposal/nfaVersionDropdown.jsx:18-47
Comments tab badge = remarks with `additionalRequestResolution = requested` — src/views/projectProposal/approvalSection/approvalSection.jsx:284-316

POST `/approval_workflow/approval_requests/:id/withdraw_approval` `{remarks (trimmed), attachments}` → "Proposal withdrawn successfully" → Master QCS tab — src/views/projectProposal/withdrawApprovalModal/api.js:4-9, src/views/projectProposal/withdrawApprovalModal/mutation.js:4-15, withdrawApprovalMo

"ARN Report" with `arnReportEnabled` (first stage); "Report" with config `allow_download_awarding_proposal_report` (category = first `applicable_report_types`, else awarding proposal report), PDF — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:705-749
Non-draft proposal: GET `/event_groups/:id/get_approvals?lot_no=` on open and every 30000 ms — src/views/projectProposal/approvalSection/approvalSection.jsx:22, 75-95

"Download" per stage only when its uuid is in `report_status_data.active_report_stage_uuids`; Master QCS download only when `master_qcs_report_status` — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:514-541, 554-577
Unresolved comment strip: "<n> unresolved comments need resolution, Please take action immediately." — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:828-845
row title is `${PROJECT_STATES[rfx_mode]?.label} QCS` || title — always truthy, so an unknown mode prints "undefined QCS" — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:518

Pending requests listed first; if none, only the latest completed one; the rest under "Request History (n)"; the request for the proposal being viewed is always pinned and bannered "Currently Viewing Approval" — src/views/projectProposal/approvalSection/helpers.js:11-39, src/views/projectProposal/ap

Condition text: selection → "(<name> is A or B)"; range → "is more than X and less than Y" with X/Y in the default currency locale (`comma`); 1 condition drops brackets; ≥3 → "<first> + N more" tooltip — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:127-183, src/utils/index.js:288-296

allocation cells use `value || "-"`, so a real 0 (e.g. 0 L1 items, ₹0) renders "-"; a range starting at 0 is printed as "less than Y" — src/views/projectProposal/allocationColumns.js:10-35, src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:153-158

Remarks required for BOTH actions: blank → "Remark is necessary for approval" / "Remark is necessary for rejection" — src/views/projectProposal/approvalSection/approvalCard.jsx:102-107, 390-399, src/translations/en.json:1097-1098
"Withdraw Proposal" menu only when proposal status = requested AND the viewer's uuid = proposal creator — src/views/projectProposal/projectProposal.jsx:316-318, 911-924
Remarks box and buttons only when the viewer is a current approver (`approverId`) — src/views/projectProposal/approvalSection/approvalCard.jsx:348-428
"Withdraw Request" disabled when the reason is blank after trim AND no attachment ("Reason *") — src/views/projectProposal/withdrawApprovalModal/withdrawApprovalModal.jsx:25, 57-70

cases.title: Document panel loads the proposal document template
steps: Wait for the document content to load.
Enter a valid answer in Enter answer here....
cases.expected: The first saved document template is loaded. The document fields are shown, and the changed section is saved automatically.
cases.setup: Use a proposal where ntd_required_on_proposal is enabled and a saved document template exists.
gaps: Assert that the first saved document template, specifically, was selected.
Move to another document section because no catalog step can identify or navigate document sections.
Verify that the changed section was saved automatically after navigation.

cases.title: Submitting with an empty required field is refused
cases.expected: The proposal is not submitted. The message "Please fill all the required fields" is shown.
cases.setup: Use a draft proposal with at least one required field empty.

cases.title: A non-creator cannot submit a proposal
cases.expected: The submit request is refused and the message "Insufficient parameters" is shown. The proposal remains unsubmitted.
cases.setup: Sign in as a viewer who is not the proposal creator. Use a draft proposal with all required fields completed.
gaps: Establishing that the current user is a non-creator of the proposal

cases.title: Comparison Sheets shows stage rows and the proposed PO form
steps: Review the displayed rows from top to bottom.
cases.expected: The rows show each applicable stage, followed by Master QCS, followed by Proposed PO form.
cases.setup: Use a proposal containing at least one lot stage and one non-RFQ or auction stage. Do not configure skip_custom_po.

cases.title: Document is read-only after the proposal leaves draft status
steps: Try to change the displayed response.
cases.expected: The document content is read-only. The response cannot be edited or autosaved.
cases.setup: Open a proposal whose status is not draft.
gaps: Whether an attempted change is autosaved or whether no autosave request is sent

cases.title: Select date remains disabled until its prerequisite is met
cases.expected: Select date is visibly disabled and does not open or accept input.
cases.setup: Open the proposal in its current state without completing any prerequisite that could make the date applicable.
gaps: The specific prerequisite for enabling Select date and the transition to an enabled state cannot be identified or verified with the catalog.
